items.comments: Jennifer was a fantastic host and resource to all things Queen Anne/Seattle.  The neighborhood is VERY walkable and public transportation is accessible. The living space was extremely comfortable and well appointed.  I would highly recommend this apartment!

Jennifer was very accommodating and the studio was in a great location and neighbourhood. Studio was everything as described and felt very homely. Just what I needed after staying in so many hotels!  Walking distance to Kerry Park, restaurants, shops and bus lines. I've also walked as far as downtown from the studio. Overall, perfect experience and would stay here again!

Jen made us feel very welcome and was very easy to contact for any information we needed. Parking was included and the studio apartment had everything we needed. Its location was ideal and within easy walking distance to the commercial district of Queen Anne.
